runtime.launcher: .exulanica/lane-comparestart/launch.py, a lane copy of the acceptance launcher: a fresh synthetic workspace on a private PostgreSQL, the API importing the lane worktree, models asked with the operator's key read inside the API process

record.scope: First milestone deliverable Independent reading. A program outside the application, written against the Python standard library only and run with -S -s -E, reads through the authenticated API the newest comparison a world's owner started from the application's Compare view: its start, its arms and every run's outcome, then every completed run of a model arm replayed by the server from what it stored, with its decisions. It checks from those reads alone that the start finished within the bound its owner stated, that every planned run has an outcome, that each model arm names its model, that every run it read was replayed from its record, and that each run's replayed decisions are the asks the comparison counted for it.
what_this_does_not_show: The comparison ran on development seeds, one seed, so it is not judged; the record shows the reading, not a difference between the models.

The token was the slot's synthetic owner grant; the client sent GET requests only, which the transcript lists, and a world.read grant alone suffices (tests/test_developer_client_comparisons.py runs it with one).
The workspace is a synthetic one on a development runtime, not a person's own world or a production deployment.
